notes: An independent baseline on how far Welsh organisations are engaged in the transition (SI11), and a counterweight to cost-focused critiques of net zero targets.
summary: On 21 May 2026 the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit published The Welsh Net Zero Economy in 2025, with analysis by CBI Economics and The Data City. It found net zero activity contributed 4.0 billion pounds of gross value added, 4.3 percent of Welsh output, and over 41,300 full-time equivalent jobs across about 1,342 employers, 87 percent of them small or medium-sized. It put the Welsh renewable generation pipeline at 13.1 billion pounds and 10.9 GW.
title: ECIU analysis values the Welsh net zero economy at 4 billion pounds of output and 41,300 jobs
